label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: After declining the cookie banner a leftover dialog with only an unlabeled-purpose button How can we use your data? stayed open on every page and stayed in the tree as a modal dialog with no heading or explanation.

element.name: How can we use your data?

findings.problem: Clicking a product link gave no feedback: the page title and tree stayed the same, so I had to re-read to learn the product page had loaded.

element.name: 4.9 out of 5 stars. 12128 reviews Stainless Clad [name] 4.7 L · Stainless €169

findings.problem: Size buttons 1.9 L, 2.8 L and 4.7 L do not say which one is selected, and the title says 5 QT while the page says 4.7 L, so I could not tell what I was adding.
After Add to Cart a pairs-well-with upsell dialog opened with no label, and View Cart was reported as covered by it; the button only said Adding, with no confirmation announced until I re-read.

The checkout page first loaded as an empty main region with no content or loading message; the form only appeared after a re-read. The country defaulted to [name], and the contact step pre-ticked the box to sign up for deals and offers, which a customer must untick to decline promotions.
